generic_name: Penicillin G Benzathine / Penicillin G Procaine
purpose: This medicine is used to treat certain bacterial infections, such as strep throat and some types of pneumonia. It combines two forms of penicillin to give you both quick and long-lasting infection-fighting coverage. Your doctor may also use it to prevent infections like rheumatic fever from coming back.
how_it_works: This antibiotic works by attacking the outer wall that bacteria need to survive and grow. Without that protective wall, the bacteria break apart and die. Your body then clears away the infection naturally. The two forms of penicillin in this shot work together — one starts working quickly and the other keeps working for a longer period of time.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects include pain, swelling, or soreness at the injection site. Some people feel mild nausea or an upset stomach. You might also notice a skin rash, itching, or mild fever. These effects are usually temporary and go away on their own.
warnings: Tell your doctor right away if you have any signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as hives, swelling of your face or throat, trouble breathing, or dizziness — this can be life-threatening. Never take this injection by mouth or inject it into a vein, as it must only be given as a deep muscle injection by a healthcare professional. Let your doctor know if you have ever had a reaction to penicillin or any other antibiotic before starting this medicine.
typical_dosing: This medication is given as a shot into the muscle, usually in the buttock area, by a nurse or doctor. The dose and how often you get it depends on your infection and your age or weight. For many infections, a single injection is all that is needed, but your doctor will decide the right schedule for you. Make sure you keep all your appointments so you get the full benefit of treatment.
